name: Yuuki
source:
Likes: Things she can num num on
Dislikes: Things she can't num num on

The cheerful girl whom [url=/c24584]Riku[/url] often played with as a child. When they meet again after Riku returns to Tsukigasaki, he’s surprised to see that her appearance hasn’t changed at all. She mysteriously appears and disappears on the bridge connecting the old district to the new district much like an illusion.
